reference_number: CAG Performance Audit Report No. 4 of 2011 · Street Lighting
title: CAG audit reconstruction — Delhi Street-Light Modernisation (CWG-2010)
source_name: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
demo_site: Demo Field Zone — Delhi CAG Case
historical_finding_summary: CAG reported the modernisation of Delhi street lighting across around 800 km of roads at a tendered cost of ₹286 crore and reported avoidable extra expenditure of ₹31.07 crore across PWD, MCD and NDMC on imported luminaries.

requirements.label: Physical presence / visible condition of installed streetlights

audit_findings.label: High-cost imported luminary procurement
audit_findings.finding: CAG reported avoidable extra expenditure of ₹31.07 crore across PWD, MCD and NDMC on imported luminaries.

audit_findings.label: Specification / evaluation gap
audit_findings.finding: CAG reported that imported and indigenous luminaries had identical technical specifications and that supporting techno-economic evaluation was not documented.

audit_findings.label: Competition / qualification concern
audit_findings.finding: CAG reported tender conditions that restricted competition and a bidder qualification/requalification issue involving SpaceAge.

audit_findings.label: Post-tender alteration concern
audit_findings.finding: CAG reported suspected post-tender alteration of MCD bids, with quoted amounts enhanced in the cases described by the audit.

key_evidence.label: Project scale
key_evidence.value: Around 800 km of Delhi roads; tendered cost ₹286 crore

key_evidence.label: Price example
key_evidence.value: Keselec-Schreder Ambar-3: ₹15,160 in PWD as indigenous vs ₹32,000 in MCD as imported

key_evidence.label: Audit impact
key_evidence.value: ₹31.07 crore avoidable extra expenditure across three agencies

investigator_next_checks: Trace the CAG findings to the underlying tender, invoice and approval records.
Compare imported and indigenous technical specifications line-by-line.
Verify the documented justification and cost-benefit analysis for imported luminaries.
Check original MCD tender files against the bid alterations described by CAG.
verification_notes: Real CAG audit reconstruction. Historical findings must remain labelled as audit evidence; the rover mission is a separate scaled demonstration and must not be presented as a new historical measurement.

reference_number: CAG Annual Technical Inspection Report on Local Bodies · 2017
title: CAG audit reconstruction — Dhanbad Municipal LED Street Lights
source_name: Comptroller and Auditor General of India
category: CAG audit reconstruction / LED street lighting
demo_site: Demo Field Zone — Dhanbad CAG Case
historical_finding_summary: CAG reported an estimate for 809 LED lights worth ₹4.15 crore, 795 supplied with ₹3.63 crore paid, and a joint physical verification of 237 lights in which 171 (72 per cent) were non-functional or improperly functioning; ₹0.79 crore relating to those lights was reported as unfruitful expenditure.

requirements.label: Installed LED streetlight presence / visible condition

audit_findings.label: Specification reduction without price reduction
audit_findings.finding: CAG reported reductions in wattage, LED efficiency and ingress protection without reducing the price.

audit_findings.label: Large non-functionality in physical verification
audit_findings.finding: Of 237 LED lights jointly physically verified, CAG found 171 (72 per cent) non-functional or improperly functioning.

audit_findings.label: Unfruitful expenditure
audit_findings.finding: CAG reported ₹0.79 crore of expenditure on the 171 lights as unfruitful.

investigator_next_checks: Compare model-estimate specifications with tendered specifications.
Review contractor responsibilities for feeder-pillar, timer, earthing and LED-panel defects.
Verify joint physical-verification records and the site-wise asset list.
Reconcile supplied quantity, payment records and functional status.
Check warranty-period corrective action and acceptance records.
verification_notes: Real CAG audit reconstruction. Historical physical-verification results belong to the audit record; any current rover findings are a separate scaled demo observation.
